title: Length of a valid configuration record
statement: Let $k,n,s$ be natural numbers, let $Q,T$ be types, and let $fs$ be a list of fields of record symbols. If $fs$ is a valid record for a configuration using $k$ work tapes, input length $n$, and window bound $s$, then joining its fields with separators produces a list of length $k(2s+1)+	ext{posWidth}(n)+k+4$.
hypotheses_covered: $fs$ is a valid record with parameters $k,n,s,Q,T$
